text.body:
nirvartya sarvakṛtyaṃ tu maṇḍale rajasāṃ punaḥ |
visarjanaṃ tu vai kuryād bhāvanābalataḥ sudhī || [9.1]
praviśya maṇḍalāgāraṃ maṇḍalaṃ vyavalokayet |
sarvabhāvāḥ svabhāvena yataḥ pratītyasamudbhavā || [9.2]
maṇḍalaṃ māṇḍaleyāś ca maṇḍaleśas tathā punaḥ |
āyātaṃ tat kutaḥ kutra tad vā yāsyati cādhunā || [9.3]
niḥsvabhām idaṃ sarvaṃ tryadhvabuddhānvitaṃ mahat |
dhyātṛdhyeyavihīnaṃ ca prakṛtyā ca nabhaḥsamam || [9.4]
vilokya svapnagandharvakaccaṭāmbuvidhūpamam |
māyāmarīcisaṃkāśaṃ kadalīphenasaṃnibham || [9.5]
% °sa[\ms15\recto]nnibham
sphuraccitram idaṃ sarvaṃ jñānajñeyavivarjitam |
prakāśākāśasaṃkāśam apratiṣṭhitalakṣaṇam || [9.6]
anantaraṃ raktaḥ cakradevatājñānaraśmibhiḥ |
samākṛṣya nabhodeśe pratiṣṭhāpya yathā yathā || [9.7]
pūrvādidvāram ārabhya tato dvāracatuṣṭayam |
svahastavajraroṣābhiḥ protkīrya koṇakān api || [9.8]
kṛto va iti mantraṃ ca paṭhan muḥkāram antataḥ |
visarjayed rajobhāgaṃ kṣīram āvāhayet tataḥ || [9.9]
dakṣiṇāvarta saṃhṛtya kurvan ccārya(?)saṃmataḥ |
ghaṇṭāvajradharaḥ śrīmān devatāgarvam udvahan || [9.10]
gomayair mārjanaṃ kṛtvā yoginyā yuktarūpayā |
dadyād ātarpaṇaṃ tatra vikāle gaṇamelakam || [9.11]
vijayākṛdghaṭe kuryād rajāṃsi vastramaṇḍite |
arghādi vidhisaṃyuktaṃ sarvaṃ balyādipūrvakam || [9.12]
caryāvratādisaṃgītisadvādyadundubhisvaraiḥ |
% caryā<|da|>vrartyadi° \ms
yoginīmelakais tatra madanānumodananditaiḥ || [9.13]
ācāryo yogaśiṣyo vā hastyādiyānasaṃsthitaḥ |
% anne yogya°?
sarvatra dattatāmbūlaś candanācarcisadvapuḥ || [9.14]
caladghargharikāghoraghaṇṭādhvanivibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
phalaiś citraṃ prapaśyadbhiḥ padātikathabhir (?) yutāḥ || [9.15]
gatvā nāgahradaṃ yad vā gambhīram ambhasaḥ sthitam |
no cet samudragāminyāṃ nadyāṃ tatrāvatared budhaḥ || [9.16]
sukhāsane 'pi tatrāpi niṣadya kṣmātale śubhe |
gomayenopalite 'pi gandhādyais tatra maṇḍalam || [9.17]
kṛtvā hṛdbījaraśmyoghair nāgān karṣayet tataḥ |
maṇḍale 'ṣṭadale padme prāgdale tatra vinyaset || [9.18]
vāsukiṃ dakṣiṇe padme karkoṭaṃ paścime dale |
uttare takṣakaṃ caiva mahāpadmaṃ tu śaṅkare || [9.19]
vahnau śaṅkhapālaṃ ca rākṣase kulikaṃ tathā |
vāyau huluṇḍanāmānaṃ kesare vajriṇaṃ tathā |
ānīyārghādikaṃ kṛtvā pūjayen mantrisattamaḥ || [9.20]
oṃ śrīvajrasattvāya hūṃ svāhā |
oṃ vāsuki hūṃ svāhā |
oṃ padma hūṃ svāhā |
oṃ kārkoṭaka hūṃ svāhā |
oṃ takṣaka hūṃ svāhā |
oṃ mahāpadma hūṃ svāhā |
oṃ śaṅkhapāla hūṃ svāhā |
oṃ kuliśapāla hūṃ svāhā |
oṃ huluṇḍa hūṃ svāhā |
puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ gandhasaṃyutam |
dattvā vaded vākyaṃ ca rajasāṃ grahaṇāya vai || [9.21]
asmin lokadhātau hi vajriṇā maṇḍalaṃ mayā |
vartitaṃ śiṣyahetoś ca bhavanto 'numodanam || [9.22]
kṛtvā rajaḥ pratīcchantu dānanāthahitāya ca |
śāsanaṃ ca ciraṃ tiṣṭhet prasādād bhavatāṃ punaḥ || [9.23]
prahṛṣṭāḥ prītisaṃjātāḥ tadanantaram eva tu |
svasvadivyāṅgaṇāvādyagītanṛtyapuraḥsarāḥ || [9.24]
yo yo tkāra(?!)puraskāramūrdhāñjalivirājitāḥ |
pratīcchanti rajas tūrṇaṃ buddhājñāparipālakāḥ || [9.25]
visṛṣṭam iti saṃcintya tv avatīryāmbhasi sudhī |
pravāhayed rajorāśiṃ kṣīraṃ prakṣipya tatra vai || [9.26]
gṛhītvā ca rajo nāgāḥ svālayaṃ satvaraṃ yayuḥ |
sānandaṃ ca savistāram āhuḥ svasvakule punaḥ || [9.27]
jambūdvīpa śubhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sacet mantrasaṃcayaḥ |
yatrādhaṃ tatra sattvāś ca bodhibhājo na saṃśayaḥ || [9.28]
% huh?
tataḥ pūgādidānena saṃtarpya madanena vā |
āgacchati tadā dhīmān dharmatāṃ vyavalokayan || [9.29]
iti rajovisarjanavidhiḥ || ||
